title: Edit, Don't Imitate: Minimal-Edit On-Policy Distillation for Multimodal Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.30231v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Visual mathematical reasoning can fail before reasoning begins: when a vision-language model (VLM) misreads a diagram, subsequent reasoning proceeds from false premises. This perceptual bottleneck is especially pronounced in smaller models, while accurate textual descriptions can substantially narrow the gap to larger models. Because obtaining such descriptions at inference requires additional annotation or model calls, we propose minimal-edit corrective on-policy distillation. Using reference figure descriptions and verified reference solutions as training-only information, a teacher scores incorrect student rollouts under a minimal-edit objective, and only teacher-disfavored tokens contribute to the corrective loss. Correct rollouts receive task-reward reinforcement learning. This preserves on-policy supervision while avoiding full-response imitation. translated_title: 编辑而非模仿：面向多模态推理的最小编辑在线策略蒸馏
translated_abstract: 视觉数学推理可能在推理开始之前就已失败：当视觉语言模型（VLM）误读图表时，后续推理将基于错误的前提进行。这种感知瓶颈在小模型中尤为明显，而准确的文本描述可以显著缩小小模型与大模型之间的差距。由于在推理阶段获取此类描述需要额外的标注或模型调用，我们提出了最小编辑纠正性在线策略蒸馏方法。该方法将参考图形描述和经过验证的参考解答仅作为训练阶段的信息，由教师模型在最小编辑目标下对学生的错误采样结果进行评分，且只有教师不认可的词元才会贡献于纠正性损失；而正确的采样结果则接受基于任务奖励的强化学习。这样既保留了在线策略监督，又避免了对完整响应的模仿。在多个模型规模上，该方法在测试时无需任何描述即可达到或超越（相应性能）。
tldr: 该论文提出最小编辑纠正性在线策略蒸馏方法，教师模型仅对学生错误采样中不认可的词元施加纠正损失、正确采样则用任务奖励强化学习，从而在测试时无需额外图形描述的情况下提升多模态数学推理能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes minimal-edit corrective on-policy distillation, where a teacher scores incorrect student rollouts under a minimal-edit objective so only teacher-disfavored tokens contribute to the corrective loss while correct rollouts receive task-reward RL, improving multimodal mathematical reasoning without requiring descriptions at test time.
